meta.note: 2026-08-10 first v3 valuation refresh. Reported facts use first-party evidence where available; FY2027E scenario EPS/multiples are model assumptions, not company guidance.

benchmark_asset.name: 台積電
benchmark_asset.thesis: 先進製程與AI/HPC需求支撐成長；任何換股都必須先勝過台積本身的預期報酬。
benchmark_asset.invalidation_condition: AI/HPC需求、先進製程利用率或毛利結構顯著惡化。

evidence.value: July sales scheduled 2026-08-10 13:30 Asia/Taipei; not yet released at 12:21 refresh

market_expectation.guardrail: Expectation gap cannot create or upgrade BUY authority.

rotation_model.note: Portfolio sizing/cash/debt/leverage ownership moved to linwuyen/Elephant.

stocks.name: 技嘉
stocks.thesis: AI Server/rack-scale基建形成高成長與低估值錯配；目前是唯一跨過TSMC +8% Alpha Spread的A級候選。
stocks.invalidation_condition: Q2若顯示營收高增沒有轉成EPS/現金流或毛利惡化，立即下修。
stocks.next_check: Q2正式財報；Q1 fundamental已超過130天freshness gate，未更新前不得升BUY。

evidence.value: Rack-scale AI infrastructure including Vera Rubin NVL72

score_coverage.rule: Missing structured factor evidence is VERIFY, never silently equivalent to negative evidence.
